title: Create src/lib/progress/historyReader.ts — count sessions and compute total runtime
description: Create a module that reads the .agent/history/ directory, counts sessions from ITERATION files, and computes total runtime from session timestamps. Returns zeros when directory is missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns correct session count from history directory
Returns correct total runtime in seconds
Returns { sessionCount: 0, totalRuntimeSeconds: 0 } when history/ is missing

steps.details: Create the file. Define: export type HistoryStats = { sessionCount: number; totalRuntimeSeconds: number }

export async function readHistoryStats(agentDir: string): Promise<HistoryStats> { const historyDir = path.join(agentDir, 'history'); if (!await fs.pathExists(historyDir)) return { sessionCount: 0, totalRuntimeSeconds: 0 }; const files = await fs.readdir(historyDir); const sessionIds = new Set(files.filter(f => f.startsWith('ITERATION-')).map(f => f.split('-')[1])); return { sessionCount: sessionIds.size, totalRuntimeSeconds: 0 } // TODO: compute runtime from timestamps }

steps.description: Compute total runtime from session timestamps
steps.details: The ITERATION files are named ITERATION-{sessionId}-{n}.txt. The sessionId is a Unix timestamp (Date.now()). Compute runtime by finding min and max timestamps per session and summing the differences.

technicalNotes: The sessionId is Date.now().toString() — parse as integer to get the Unix timestamp in milliseconds
Each session's runtime = lastIterationTime - sessionId (approximate, since we don't store end time)
